page.content:
Fourth-dynasty royal tombs on the Giza plateau.

How Pyramids of Giza connects

  • Location: Memphis — The Giza pyramids belong to Memphis' Old Kingdom hinterland.
  • Work: Pyramid Texts — Pyramid Texts developed in Old Kingdom royal pyramids, the ideology Giza embodies.

What is Pyramids of Giza?

The pyramids of Giza — Khufu, Khafre, Menkaure — are Old Kingdom machines for the king's ascent, aligned with solar and stellar ideology beside Memphis.

Key threads lead to Memphis and Pyramid Texts.
